text: To reset the router, hold the small recessed button on the back panel for ten seconds until all the front lights blink simultaneously, then release it. Wait about two minutes for the device to fully reboot before attempting to reconnect any devices. If the lights don't blink, you may be holding the wrong button — check that it's the one labeled RESET, not WPS.

Osmosis is the movement of water molecules across a semi-permeable membrane from a region of lower solute concentration to a region of higher solute concentration, continuing until equilibrium is reached or the pressure difference across the membrane balances the concentration gradient. It requires no external energy input, unlike active transport.
